description: Cryptstalker Tunic Level 60 Huntsman Leopold at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Cryptstalker Tunic if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Tunic, 25 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 4 Arcanite Bars and 3 Cured Rugged Hides. Requirements: - Desecrated Tunic - Wartorn Chain Scrap x 25 - Arcanite Bar x 4 - Cured Rugged Hide x 3
name: Cryptstalker Tunic
